nuggets.text: The Pioneers are playing their first season in CAA Football after two years as an independent.
Dean Hangey caught five passes for 110 yards and two touchdowns in the Pioneers' CAA debut at Monmouth.
Sacred Heart quarterback Poochie Snyder's real first name is Jack, the same as his father, a former quarterback.
Mark Nofri has been on Sacred Heart's coaching staff since 1994, when he started as defensive backs coach.
Mark Nofri has won five Northeast Conference Coach of the Year awards.
Sacred Heart's 2001 team went a perfect 11-0 and won the school's first conference championship.
The Pioneers earned their first national ranking in 2014, No. 24 in The Sports Network poll.
Sacred Heart's mascot is Big Red the Pioneer.
The Pioneers went 8-4 last season, their final year as an independent.
The Pioneers won six Northeast Conference titles before leaving that league after the 2023 season.
